title: Modelling the trophic interaction, structure, and function of the northern North Sea food web: Ecopath Technical Report
authors: Clare Evelyn Hill; Jacob W. Bentley; Natalia Serpetti; Clive Fox; Chevonne Angus; Johanna Heymans
documentation_evidence: Dedicated technical report describes topology, parameter sources, diet and balancing of northern North Sea model.
loadability_evidence: Native EwE loadability has not been tested. Public documentation or data availability alone does not establish a fully working reconstruction.
loadability_class: C — parameter and diet tables inspected; model import not tested
quality_rationale: UHI PDF title/authors verified120pages. Section1 gives group inputs and balancing changes. Table47 printed93/PDF98 and continuation printed94/PDF99 balanced diet matrix (continuation mislabelled Table42). No native load test. Full model import and numerical reconstruction remain untested.
extraction_readiness: Parameter and diet tables located; transcription and balance audit required
geometry_method: No defensible digital study boundary located
recommendation: Northern North Sea with Shetland fisheries emphasis; subregional model.
coverage_note: Northern North Sea with Shetland fisheries emphasis; subregional model.
